messages:
alex_support: customer reported intermittent 400 when calling tool with 'args' payload. says it works sometimes from mac but fails from windows CI. pasted request body:

```json
{
  "file_path": "C:\Users\build\artifacts\output.json",
  "options": {
    "compress": true,
  },
}
```

response: `400 Bad Request - invalid_tool_args: JSON parse error at character 128`

alex_support: customer says they copy-paste from a PowerShell here-string and sometimes forget to escape backslashes; also their client sends content-type `text/plain` from the CI runner. asking for repro steps and whether we can make parser error clearer / tolerate trailing commas.

sam_engineer: can you paste the exact curl or SDK call they used? my hunch: trailing commas + text/plain cause our parser to attempt a lenient parse then fail. also windows backslashes often collapse if not double-escaped.

alex_support: pasted customer's curl (redacted auth):

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/call_tool \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" \n  -H "Content-Type: text/plain" \n  --data-binary @payload.txt
```

payload.txt contents (customer):

```
{"file_path":"C:\Users\build\artifacts\output.json","options":{"compress":true,},}
```

priya_repro: I reproduced using PowerShell here-string on Win11 + node 18. When file is uploaded as text/plain our service treats it as raw string and tries to parse JSON heuristically; trailing comma trips our strict parser path. If you send content-type application/json it goes through the JSON body path which gives clearer parse errors.

priya_repro: repro steps I used:
1) create payload.txt with the here-string exactly as above
2) `curl -H "Content-Type: text/plain" --data-binary @payload.txt https://api.redwood.ai/v1/call_tool`
3) get `invalid_tool_args` 400

priya_repro: quick workaround for customer: either remove the trailing commas, or escape backslashes when creating the file in PowerShell, or set `-H "Content-Type: application/json"` and ensure payload is valid JSON. Example sanitized payload:

```json
{"file_path":"C:\Users\build\artifacts\output.json","options":{"compress":true}}
```

sam_engineer: thanks. I'll add a short note in the support KB and improve error message to mention trailing commas and content-type mismatch. we shouldn't auto-strip commas (could mask bugs) but we can return `invalid_json_trailing_comma` with hint. filing an engineering ticket.

alex_support: customer is ok with workaround but asked for a better client-side error so they can fail fast in CI. can we add a one-liner in the SDK to validate args before sending?

sam_engineer: yes, SDK teams can add a small preflight JSON.parse + schema check for tool args. i'll create PR and link it here.

deploy-bot: triggered build for branch `fix/support-toolargs-err` (CI #4123) :white_check_mark:

priya_repro: attached a minimal node repro gist (private) and note: PowerShell here-strings will produce single backslashes unless you `Replace('','\')` before writing. flagged in gist. :memo:

alex_support: closing loop with customer and sending steps + example. marking as resolved pending SDK PR. :thumbsup:

sam_engineer: created ticket INF-6789 to add explicit error code + SDK preflight. assigning to sdk-team.

alex_support: thanks all. leaving thread open for SDK PR link.
